analysis.summary: Sonam Limited reported a significant increase in financial performance for the first half of FY27, with revenue reaching Rs. 195 crores and profit after tax growing to Rs. 6.75 crores. Management highlighted that growth is driven primarily by domestic markets, premium range wall clock launches, and increased trading activities in raw materials such as polymers. While export freight costs and raw material price pressures impacted margins, the company targets higher annual revenues of Rs.

guidance.claim: Revenue for the financial year is expected to be around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore.
guidance.quote: According to us revenue is around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore. We hope it should be that.

guidance.claim: Management targets achieving a PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore and an EPS of Rs. 5 to Rs. 6 by 2028, 2029.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and do PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore. And our EPS becomes Rs. 5 to Rs. 6.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.
guidance.quote: you have given the guidance that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.

guidance.claim: Management expressed hope that the 25% to 30% growth will be sustained.
guidance.quote: Yes, we hope that 25% to 30% growth will be sustained.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue for the next quarter to be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth is coming more from domestic markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, our growth is coming more from domestic.

demand_outlook.claim: The focus is now more on domestic markets because prices and freight costs have increased a lot in exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes, the focus is more on domestic now. Naturally, because now the price has increased a lot in exports. Freight cost has increased a lot. So according to that, we are focusing more on domestic now.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand increased because the company developed a lot of models and expanded distribution channels.
demand_outlook.quote: It is because of that. And the second thing is that according to domestic, we have developed a lot of models. So according to that, we have got a good response.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted deadly demand across the company's product portfolio during the first quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported that the positive market response to new products has been encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The positive market response to this new product has been encouraging and strengthens our confidence in our long-term growth strategy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that going forward there is festival season.
demand_outlook.quote: And going forward there is festival season, so according to us whatever was there in the 1st Quarter that much should be there.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin stood at 6.7% compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.7% compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: Imported goods have an average operating margin of 3% to 4%, while trading and manufacturing activities have a 21% gross profit.
margins_costs.quote: Actually, in imported goods, we have an average margin of 3% to 4% and the average margin in trading activity and in manufacturing activity, there is 21% gross profit.

margins_costs.claim: To lower manufacturing costs, the company is moving into the premium range to increase selling value.
margins_costs.quote: But, now to put the cost down we are going in the premium range. So, because of that our selling value will increase. So, cost will come down automatically after selling value increase.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that raw material is purchased in advance for six to seven months when an increase is expected.
margins_costs.quote: At the time when the raw material is expected to increase, we purchase raw material for six, seven months.

orders_capacity.claim: The capacity utilization for now is 52%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization for now is 52%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has started making clocks for Titan and Amazon as part of its OEM business.
orders_capacity.quote: Actually we have started making clocks for Titan. Titan, Amazon, we are also making clocks for Amazon.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that capacity utilization is 60% to 70% on a quarter-to-quarter basis.
Management identified Sonam as the second largest clock manufacturer in India.
orders_capacity.quote: We are the second largest clock manufacturer and in India we are the first manufacturer who are providing more new products.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated there are no requirements for additional borrowing for now.

risks_headwinds.claim: Freight costs increased in exports, resulting in lower export volumes and an impact at the manufacturing level.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually this year freight cost has increased in export. So, according to that export is a little less. There is an effect on export. Accordingly, it is a little less at the manufacturing level.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material prices increased in the market, prompting the company to use special schemes and discounts to grow the business.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually, the raw material prices got increased in the market but we focused more on the business and by giving special schemes and special discount we grew the business.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted there is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to provide maximum benefit to shareholders and achieve a PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore with an EPS of Rs. 5 to Rs. 6.
management_commitments.quote: Our plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and do PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore. And our EPS becomes Rs. 5 to Rs. 6.

management_commitments.claim: The company will launch eight to ten new models in the coming two, three months.
management_commitments.quote: And in the coming two, three months we will launch eight to ten new models.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated plans to sell clocks in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in the years 2027-28.
management_commitments.quote: So, our segment, our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
